about.title: About TurfBari
about.subtitle: Book a turf the way it should be: simple and quick.
about.body: TurfBari connects players with turfs across Bangladesh. Instead of calling around to find a free ground, you search by date, sport and time, see only the turfs that are actually available, and book the slot online. Turf owners manage their grounds, prices and bookings in one place, so what you see is what's really open.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.subtitle: Quick answers about booking on TurfBari.

q1.q: How do I book a turf?
q1.a: Open Find Turfs, choose a date, sport and time, and pick a turf with an open slot. Select the slot you want and confirm. You'll need to be signed in to complete the booking.

q2.a: You can browse turfs and see open slots without one. To book and to see your bookings you need a free account, which you can create with your phone number or email.

q3.a: Your slot is reserved for you and no one else can book it. The turf then confirms the booking, and the status changes to Confirmed.

q4.a: Payment is arranged with the turf. If a turf asks for an advance, the amount is shown before you confirm, and on your booking page afterwards.

q5.q: Can I cancel or change a booking?
q5.a: Please contact the turf or our support team and they will help you. Cancelled slots are released so others can book them.

q6.q: Some turfs offer more than one sport. How does that work?
q6.a: A single ground can host several sports, for example cricket and football. When you book one of these turfs you choose which sport you are playing.
